fields.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Lamb''' {{tip|dashes}} toward the target location, gaining {{sti|attack speed|{{as|35%|attack speed}}}} {{as|(+ 5% per {{ai|Mark of the Kindred|Kindred|mark}})|buzzword}} {{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}} for 4 seconds and firing an arrow at up to 3 nearby {{tip|sight|visible}} enemies that deals {{as|physical damage}}. Her current attack target within any proximity will be prioritized by one of the arrows.
fields.description2: ''Dance of Arrows' '' {{sti|'''total''' cooldown}} is reduced to an amount while '''Lamb''' is within the area of ''{{ai|Wolf's Frenzy|Kindred}}''. Casting ''{{ai|Wolf's Frenzy|Kindred}}'' reduces ''Dance of Arrows' '' '''current''' cooldown to the same amount.
fields.description3: ''Dance of Arrows {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Lamb's''' basic attack timer. '''Lamb''' can cast any of her [[champion ability|abilities]] during the dash.''

dataPolicy.blockedDataPolicy: DDragon is provenance at most, NEVER current numeric truth. A mechanism may remain blocked_data only when the checked League Wiki template itself lacks or marks unknown the required numeric contract.
